name: [CODE FREECASE] Combat Surf!
desc:
Combat Surf is a fast paced movement shooter which requires knowledge of surfing and strafing.
Get FREE CASES from levelling up and winning matches!
Press M for Menu, TAB for leaderboard, Q to switch weapons
Shutdown = Update
Cheating = Ban
Private servers are free! do !cmds to see cmds
Console Players require mouse and keyboard. There is no controller support.
